# Backend Scripts

This directory contains utility scripts for the backend application.

## Available Scripts

### Cleanup Scripts

- `cleanup-temp-docx.js` - Removes temporary DOCX files
### Data Scripts

- `generate-test-data.ts` - Generates test data for development
- `seed-languages.ts` - Seeds the database with supported languages

## Running Scripts

To run a TypeScript script:

```bash
npx ts-node scripts/script-name.ts
```

To run a JavaScript script:

```bash
node scripts/script-name.js
```
